method.description: Disease severty index of foliar symptoms in a field infested with Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. vasinfectum race 1 and root-knot nematodes.  FOV foliar disease severity Index scale: 0 = no symptoms; 1 = epinasty and slight dwarfing; 2 = 1 to 30% of leaves chlorotic; 3 = 31 to 80% of leaves chlorotic and severe stunting; 4 = 81 to 100% of leaves chlorotic; and 5 = plant death

trait.description: Severity of fusarium wilt disease, caused by the Fusarium wilt fungus (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. vasinfectum)

method.description: Disease severty index of vascular root stain in a field infested with Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. vasinfectum race 1 and root-knot nematodes.  Vascular Root Staining: 0 = no vascular root staining evident, 1 = light vascular root staining evident as spotty areas, 2 = more continuous than 1, but light colored staining  covering an area between one quarter and one half of the stem cross-section, 3 = moderate brown/black staining evident in a band encircling most of the stem cross section, 4 = brown/black staining evident across most vascular tissue in stem cross section, and 5 = plant severely damaged or plant death with staining evident throughout a cross-section of root tissue

trait.description: The spinning consistency index (FSCI) is a calculation for predicting the overall quality and spinnability of the cotton fiber

method.description: Fiber Spinning Consistency Index (SCI)  is an HVI measurement calculated value based on a regression equation. This equation takes into account all HVI properties and calculates one value to be used on each sample tested. The SCI is an index derived with data from a large number of cotton samples having a wide range in properties that is related to test data from yarn spun from each sample
method.formula: SCI = – 414.67 + (2.9 x Strength) – (9.32 x Mic) + (49.17 x Length in inch) + (4.74 x Uniformity Index) + (0.65 x Rd) + (0.36 x +b)
